description: Create Amazon listings for up to 25 products — a REAL publication on the seller's Amazon account. Each product runs the full check again (Amazon's dry run included) and is refused with Amazon's own sentences if anything changed; a product whose barcode Amazon already knows becomes an offer on that existing item. Run check_amazon_readiness first and pass only ready products. Refused until the owner switches on AI publishing, and while listing creation is not armed on the Amazon connection. Returns created (with the ASIN or SKU), failed (reason, details) and notAttemptedIds. Never tell the user a listing is live unless it is in created. Not idempotent: a product already listed fails with alreadyListed. The result echoes the workspace.

productIds.description: The products to publish, at most 25 ready ids from check_amazon_readiness.

items.description: A product id returned by search_products.
